answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in ferrous, checked in falcon, and anchor exposes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 19 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4191 identities would post 2244 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
